function: KRR predicts HAP artificial-noise power and beamforming vector per time slot of a LEO pass to maximize the minimum secrecy rate (p. 6, p. 8)
system: LEO satellite (560 km, 8x8 UPA) plus HAP (20 km, 4x4 UPA, artificial noise), 5 ground users, 2 eavesdroppers; Ku-band, 12 GHz; no RIS (p. 3, p. 10)
method: Supervised kernel ridge regression (RBF) on SCA solutions at adaptively chosen key slots, mapping satellite angle to power and beamformer; warm-started SCA generates labels (p. 8, p. 9)
data_channel: Custom LoS model (free-space loss, antenna gain, phase delay, UPA response); users and eavesdroppers random within 20 km; no 3GPP model or measured data (p. 5, p. 10)
test_conditions: KRR trained per distance case on 7 to 19+ key slots (1-degree grid, 30-150 degrees), tested on the remaining slots of the same pass (p. 8, p. 10)
baselines: Non-learned only: no artificial noise, traditional null-space AN, per-slot SCA optimization; no earlier learned method compared (p. 10)
metrics: Minimum secrecy rate, user fairness index, average SCA iterations, runtime, offline training and online inference time (p. 11, p. 12)
complexity: KRR training O(Nkey^3), inference O(Nkey); total O(Nkey Isca Csca + Ctr + T Cte) vs O(T Isca Csca) per-slot; inference 0.05-0.06 s (p. 9, p. 12)
q1_support: p. 5: "free-space propagation loss, antenna gain, phase delay, and" - custom deterministic LoS model; no 3GPP TR 38.811 model, public ray-tracing dataset or measurement is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 9: "During the online phase, for any angular position" - KRR predicts other slots of the same pass and deployment, trained per distance case (Table 4, p. 12); no unseen deployment, band or array is tested.
q3_support: p. 10: "We compare four schemes," - without AN, traditional AN, per-slot optimization and the proposal; all baselines are non-learned, so no earlier learned method of the same class is compared.
q4_support: p. 9: "the training cost is typically given by" - Section III-E gives the complexity orders of KRR and of per-slot SCA; Tables 3 and 4 (p. 12) give runtimes.
q5_support: p. 10: "reproducibility, fixed random seeds were used for NumPy." - only seeds are mentioned; no code or data link, DOI or public dataset appears anywhere in the 13 pages.
notes: Area 6 proposed (satellite and HAP link, power and HAP beamformer predicted by the learner; more specific than area 3). The objective is secrecy rate (physical-layer security), so the reviewer should confirm that this counts as beam and power control and not as an excluded function. KRR is a non-deep supervised regressor trained on SCA labels. Tables 2-6 were read from the page images (p. 11, p. 12).
